input.baselineEvidence: one schema-valid previously evaluated candidate record; completion is required for proposal eligibility
input.candidateEvidence: one schema-valid current candidate record; completion is required for proposal eligibility

eligibility.pixelReference: identical request, output, PNG, viewport, and interpretation identity
eligibility.evidenceIntegrity: both evidence fingerprints and every self-contained retained nested fingerprint reproduce; opaque upstream identities are compared but not recomputed
eligibility.candidateGate: safety through structure passed and exact-pixels failed
eligibility.baselineGate: same exact-pixel denominator with strictly fewer mismatched pixels and no larger maximum channel delta
eligibility.difference: exactly one existing properties field has a different non-expression typed value
eligibility.localization: the changed Design IR node has at least one attributed mismatched pixel
eligibility.targetValue: the exact typed value retained by baseline Design IR
eligibility.revalidation: every emitted patch must still pass the existing patch applier and six-gate evaluator

checked: rollback target values come only from an integrity-verified better baseline
one changed properties field on one pixel-attributed node
same exact-pixel denominator and strict mismatch improvement
no inferred value from pixel location, OCR, vision, or layout findings
typed patch remains subject to the complete six-gate evaluator
notClaimed: repair of a novel screenshot mismatch without a better baseline
text, color, dimension, modifier, resource, structure, behavior, or accessibility inference
causality between an attributed node and every changed pixel
perceptual similarity or arbitrary source repair
